obligor_name: Sequoia Living (fka Northern California Presbyterian Homes and Services)
_communities_note_2019: At 2019-12-31, Sequoia operated 3 mature LPCs. Viamonte (4th community, Walnut Creek) was UNDER CONSTRUCTION — financing closed May 2018 ($45.23M Series 2018A + Series 2018B-1 Entrance Fee CSCDA Cal-Mortgage insured), opened December 2020.

fitch._note: Underlying credit not publicly rated; AA- reflects Cal-Mortgage State of California insurance enhancement on Viamonte Series 2018 and other Cal-Mortgage insured bonds

rating_actions_in_window.action: No specific rating action surfaced in window — Sequoia is Cal-Mortgage enhanced not direct-rated
rating_actions_in_window.source: Cal-Mortgage insured Sequoia bonds carry State of California Cal-Mortgage rating; underlying obligor not separately rated by Fitch/S&P during this window per public sources

material_events_in_window.event: Viamonte (new Walnut Creek LPC) lost 31% of entrance-fee deposits during COVID delay — meaningful adverse event for new-development project bonds
Viamonte at Walnut Creek opened — initial occupancy challenged by COVID; first move-ins delayed several months from late summer 2020 target, lost service fee revenue
CARES Act / HHS Provider Relief Fund deposit of $240,250 to Sequoia Living

verified_outcome._notes: Cal-Mortgage insurance carried through window unchanged. Viamonte fill-up was materially stressed (31% deposit loss, 4-mo delay) but did NOT trigger Cal-Mortgage claim or covenant default per public disclosures. New-build CCRC in COVID = textbook risk; Sequoia survived but balance sheet was likely stretched.

ccrc_occupancy._warning: PDF binary not extractable. Sequoia 3 mature LPCs typically run high entrance-fee IL occupancy (90%+) given Bay Area waitlists. Viamonte opening late 2020 was the wild card.

ma_events_2020_2021.event: Viamonte opened with 30% lost deposits and delayed fill-up — Cal-Mortgage-insured Series 2018 bonds; new-development risk crystallized
ma_events_2020_2021.credit_impact: Negative for entrance-fee 2018B-1 series; pro formas held but tested

framework_signal_check.outcome_realized: FILL_UP_STRESS but Cal-Mortgage protected; no default
